name: Eiji Tadashi
source:
With a hidden past which tailored him inot the hardened survivor that he is now, Eiji is the oldest and plays the role of the mentor in the group. He is the voice of reason when things turn sour and Durchhalten relies on him to make the right decisions. Despite being only in his mid-20s, he is mocked about his old age because of his terrible sense of direction.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
